title: plotly_chart updating results flickering since Version 1.35.0
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

When updating a plotly_chart, with for ex. a scatter_mapbox, the resulting map is flickering.
This was not the case before the 1.35.0 upgrade.

### Reproducible Code Example

[![Open in Streamlit Cloud](https://static.streamlit.io/badges/streamlit_badge_black_white.svg)](https://issues.streamlitapp.com/?issue=gh-8782)

```Python
import random
import time

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import streamlit as st

dfData = {'longitude': [0.0], 'latitude': [0.0]}
df = pd.DataFrame(dfData)

mapData = px.scatter_mapbox(df, lat="latitude", lon="longitude", zoom=6, width=400, height=300)
mapData.update_layout(mapbox_style="open-street-map")

latitude = 57.0
longitude = -110.0

mapDisplay = st.empty()
while True:
    latitude += random.uniform(-0.005, 0.005)
    longitude += random.uniform(-0.005, 0.005)
    mapData.data[0].lat = [latitude]
    mapData.data[0].lon = [longitude]
    mapData.update_layout(mapbox_center={"lat": latitude, "lon": longitude})
    mapDisplay.plotly_chart(mapData, use_container_width=True)
    time.sleep(0.1)
```


### Steps To Reproduce

In order to reproduce the issue update streamlit to 1.35.0 (currently latest) version and run the code above.
To get it working nicely downgrade to 1.34.0.

### Expected Behavior

Expected would be a non flickering updating of the map.

### Current Behavior

Sadly the chart flickers as its been updated.

### Is this a regression?

- [X] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.35.0
- Python version: 3.8.10
- Operating System: Ubuntu 20.04
- Browser: Tested on Vivaldi (Chrome), Firefox, Edge on Android


### Additional Information

_No response_

[USER] Thanks for reporting this issue. I reproduced it [here](https://issues.streamlit.app/?issue=gh-8782). This is mostly expected with the new version since we added a stable identity to a plotly chart based on its parameters. Changing the parameter will create a new frontend instance for the plotly chart. This resolved various other issues with plotly, but negatively impacted this type of usecase of updating plotly charts. We should probably provide a way via the `key` parameter to keep the plotly chart identity stable.
